description: This file defines the configuration for the OpenID Authentication plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It implements the PluginConfigurationInterface and registers the SocialMediaAuthenticationService with the service container during initialization.

classes.name: OpenidAuthenticationPluginConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for the OpenID Authentication plugin, responsible for setting up the authentication service during initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering the SocialMediaAuthenticationService with the service container.
